objetivo: My things and where they are

paginas.texto: Mateo loses things. Not sometimes. Every single day, and usually before nine o'clock.
On Monday he lost his gloves. They were in his pocket, which is where gloves live.
On Tuesday he lost his scarf. Luna had it. Luna thought it was a present.
On Wednesday he lost his bag, with his homework, his lunch and somebody else's book inside.
'Where did you go this morning?' asked Sofia, who solves these things with questions, not with luck.
'The track, the library, the garden and the kitchen.' So they walked all four, in that order.
The bag was under the bench at the track, exactly where he sat down to tie his shoe.
'You do not lose things,' said Sofia. 'You put them down and walk away. That is different.'
Now Mateo has a rule: before he stands up, he counts his things. It works on most days.
